<script>
function anjOpenMehndi(card){
  var img = card.querySelector("img");
  document.getElementById("anjMehndiLarge").src = img.src;
  document.getElementById("anjMehndiLightbox").classList.add("show");
}
function anjCloseMehndi(){
  document.getElementById("anjMehndiLightbox").classList.remove("show");
}
</script>
